title: Book's claim of alien contact at Bentwaters, disputed by witnesses

tellings.quote: about that there was actual contact with aliens at bent wers in 1980

plain: A book called Left at East Gate claims that in 1980 there was actual contact with aliens at RAF Bentwaters, a military air base in England, during a series of UFO sightings there. The UFO documentary maker James Fox brings the claim up and says the men who were at the base at the time, including Gordon Williams, Charles Halt, Jim Penniston and John Burroughs, dispute that any such contact took place.
